raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillermo Cuadra who sees an offensive foul.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
89' Vicente Moreno prepares a substitution. Ante Budimir is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
89' Here comes a substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz is brought on as a substitute for Aimar Oroz (Osasuna).
85' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
82' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) and he is replaced by Peio Canales.
82' The substitution has been made. Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) has replaced Unai Nunez.
79' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
77' The foul by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) was seen by Guillermo Cuadra who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
77' The attendance for today's match is 49671.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Ibanez is coming onto the pitch as Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' That will be all from Jesus Areso who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
75' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) sends a long ball in, but Unai Simon comfortably gathers the ball.
71' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
70' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
69' Today's match ends for Ruben Garcia who will be replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
69' Here is a change. Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Gorka Guruzeta.
66' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
64' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ruben Pena (Osasuna) for Jon Moncayola.
61' Here's the change. Jesus Areso leaves the pitch and Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
61' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
60' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.

58' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Aitor Fernandez makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
58' Here comes a substitution. Oscar de Marcos is given a rest as he is replaced by Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao).
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Benat Prados Diaz will be replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
56' Half-chance! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) plays a pass into the box, but Aitor Fernandez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
53' A pass by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
50' A cross into the box from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
49' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
48' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' What was Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
38' Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao) is booked.
37' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
35' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

35' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
33' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.

32' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Aitor Fernandez pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
27' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) jumps into a tackle and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul.
26' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
25' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) steps up to send the ball in.

25' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
25' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
22' Ath Bilbao restart play with a quick free kick.
22' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick.
20' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is adjudged offside.
20' The free kick is delivered by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
20' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
14' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for a foul. Guillermo Cuadra had a clear view and blows his whistle.
12' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' The ball is cleared after Jesus Areso (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' A dangerous towering header by Lucas Torro (Osasuna) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
5' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
4' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
2' The referee awards a corner and Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) goes over to take it.
2' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
2' A cross from Abel Bretones (Osasuna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Osasuna.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra was nominated as the referee for this game.
